evidence.observation: "Count duplicate evidence separately from distinct rows." The referenced CG1 draft spec also says identical rows from distinct documents need an explicit provenance ruling, but the plan supplies no expected result.

concerns.recommendation: Specify how one tuple supported by two documents is stored, counted, previewed and replayed; test repeated observations from both the same and different documents.
concerns.title: Duplicate rows lack a provenance contract

evidence.observation: "Preview row moves and role rewrites together" specifies a combined preview but does not require an atomic apply or rollback if either rewrite fails.

concerns.recommendation: Require one atomic publication of row moves and role rewrites, and verify that an injected failure between them leaves the model unchanged.
concerns.title: Combined rewrites are not required to publish atomically

evidence.observation: "restart from the decision log and verify that the declined group is not offered again unless its evidence changes" checks declined decisions only. It does not define replay behavior for an accepted merge.

concerns.recommendation: Bind accepted decisions to their input state and test restart after an applied merge, including repeated replay and changed source evidence, without duplicate rows or repeated rewrites.
concerns.title: Accepted merges have no replay contract

evidence.observation: The exit criterion says "Index singleton types, role-player and reading shapes, name similarity, units and counted nouns." The specified fixtures only "shuffle model declaration order" and include "two similarly named types with incompatible role players"; they do not require a candidate for each listed cue.

concerns.recommendation: Add positive, differently named witness cases for each discovery cue and assert the complete expected candidate set and evidence locations.
concerns.title: Discovery tests do not establish candidate completeness

evidence.observation: The loop will "recompute candidates after apply and stop at the configured threshold," while §6 asks to "Record work counters and the first refusal where limits apply." Neither passage sets a discovery work limit or a no-progress termination rule.

concerns.recommendation: Define budgets for candidate generation and loop iterations, plus a no-progress stop; test a large dense candidate set and a decision that leaves the model unchanged.
concerns.title: Candidate generation and the review loop lack enforceable bounds

evidence.observation: CG1 permits additions to a "locally owned fact" and requires validation of the extended population. The verification instruction uses the issue reproduction and §4 criterion, without a case that attempts to change a source-owned fact or introduces a conflicting constraint from a second document.

concerns.recommendation: Specify the refusal and unchanged-state result for additions to a nonlocal fact and for a second document whose constraint conflicts with the existing model; include both in CG1 acceptance.
concerns.title: Ownership and conflicting-constraint refusals are not demonstrated

response.summary: The plan covers the intended phases but leaves several safety and acceptance contracts unresolved.
